decision.name: ADD_EXPLICIT_SNAPSHOT_WITNESS_TO_TWO_WRITER_ORACLE
decision.finding: Exact public runner.run_once returns archive_records_loaded and scoring_records_loaded, enabling an objective snapshot-order witness in addition to nested source_record_id. Require A archive_records_loaded=0 and B archive_records_loaded=1 at identical T; otherwise a green disk check can be vacuous if A did not actually read the older snapshot. This sharpens acceptance without changing Specialist code or conflating atomic JSON visibility with monotonic handoff generation.
decision.runnable_no_network_contract: Approved test-only spawn-safe module-level multiprocessing targets in disposable exact-SHA checkout. With network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=T, A starts against empty archive; A child monkeypatches only runner.atomic_write_json for anata_latest.json to pause after building its handoff. Assert A archive_records_loaded=0 and A source_evidence excludes rowB. Parent appends one valid FlowObservation(family='etf',metric='etf_netflow_btc',asset='BTC',source='fixture_two_writer',source_record_id='rowB',provenance={'context_only': ' false '},effective/available/observed<=T). While A paused, B completes run_once at same T; require B archive_records_loaded=1, scoring_records_loaded=1, nested source_evidence[etf,fixture_two_writer,scoring].clock_provenance.effective.source_record_id='rowB', disk equals B anata_output. Release A; both child exitcodes=0; final disk must retain B's handoff and rowB. Reverse completion order as negative control; bound Event/Queue waits and cleanup in finally. Record observed RED/GREEN, never assume failure.
decision.no_gemini_task: Reliability unverified; no independent red reproduction; pending empty alone insufficient.

execution_blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Provide authorized disposable checkout at exact public SHA and approved test-only overlay; execute commands; preserve overlay SHA256, git HEAD, child exit codes, non-skipped counts, stdout/stderr for Planner C.
